{{Quote|That's all of 'em. You're clear to take off, transport ''Luminous''.''"<br />"''That was close! Thanks for the cover, Commander Skywalker!|Luke Skywalker and the ''Luminous'' crewman, during the evacuation of Yavin 4|<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual served as a '''crewman''' aboard the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Luminous/Legends|Luminous]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], in the immediate aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the crewman was stationed aboard the ''Luminous'' as the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] attempted to evacuate the Rebellion's [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] [[Great Temple/Legends|headquarters]] in the face of a large-scale [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Attack on Yavin 4|invasion]]. He [[Comlink/Legends|communicated]] with Rebel [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], flying an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]], while Skywalker cleared the way for the ''Luminous''{{'s}} departure by destroying inbound Imperial forces.
